DIII Kolas Tracker · 2026

Where every DIII team would stand if the field were picked by Kolas-style points after each big weekend: wins over teams already in the field, with set tiebreakers.

Regional order

1 · 10 regional winnersWhoever is first in each region in the regional order you choose above.
2 · 22 picks off the boardBoard = best team left in each region. Each round, the board team with the most wins over teams already in the field goes in.
3 · TiebreakersHead-to-head among the tied teams, then common opponents in the field, then projected regional place.
Countable resultsSept 21 onward, and only meets where a team ran at least 5 of its projected regional top 7.
